sloka: ततो ऽवघोषय पुरे गजस्कन्धेन पार्थिव।हतो रामः सह भ्रात्रा ससैन्य इति सर्वतः ।। ६.६४.२७ ।।
transliteration: tato 'vaghoṣaya pure gajaskandhena pārthiva।hato rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā sasainya iti sarvataḥ ।। 6.64.27 ।।

translations.english: "Thereafter mounted on elephant backs all over the city will make a rakshasa pronounce that Rama accompanied by his brother are killed."
